units.source_text: 我曾看過那個男人的三張照片。

en.t: I have seen three photographs of that man.

units.source_text: 第一張照片應該是他幼年時代的吧，估計也就十歲前後。

en.t: The first photograph must have been from his childhood, probably when he was around ten years old.

units.source_text: 這個男孩被很多女人圍著（不難想象出是他的親姐妹，或是堂姐妹），

en.t: The boy is surrounded by many women, whom one can easily imagine to be his sisters or cousins,

units.source_text: 他穿著粗條紋褲裙，站在庭園的水池邊，頭向左歪了大約三十度，露出難看的笑容。

en.t: wearing coarsely striped hakama, standing beside a pond in a garden, with his head tilted about thirty degrees to the left and an ugly smile on his face.

units.source_text: 即使反應遲鈍的人（就是說對美與醜毫無感覺的人），

en.t: Even dull people, that is, people with no feeling at all for beauty or ugliness,

units.source_text: 也會以一副無所謂的表情說出「這男孩兒真可愛啊」這種敷衍的客套話，

en.t: might say with an indifferent expression some perfunctory politeness like, This boy is so cute,

units.source_text: 也不至於讓人覺得是虛情假意的恭維。

en.t: and it would not necessarily strike anyone as false flattery.

units.source_text: 從這男孩兒的笑臉上，也不是看不出人們常說的「可愛」之處。

en.t: In the boy's smiling face, one cannot say there is absolutely none of what people commonly call cuteness.
